independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. sentenceIntentions.text: The assistant that makes your life easier may also make leaving its world harder.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Pair useful assistance with difficult exit

sentenceIntentions.text: Ecology of Predation explores that tension through an ordinary day in a possible future shaped by AI.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book's possible AI society

sentenceIntentions.text: An imagined household relies on an agent for contracts, purchases, family information, and daily coordination.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Locate the inquiry in Mara's ordinary household services
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See concrete resources and relationships at stake

sentenceIntentions.text: Each service helps, while the relationships around it can accumulate data, influence, and bargaining power.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel concern without inventing a single malicious actor

sentenceIntentions.text: The book uses careful comparisons with ecology to examine resources, adaptation, and the cost of leaving.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain the ecological lens through resources and adaptation
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect connected relationships rather than an isolated villain

sentenceIntentions.text: It follows connected pressures rather than imagining a simple chase between predator and prey.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Avoid reading technical systems as literal predators

sentenceIntentions.text: Small conveniences become more troubling when the same provider begins holding every key.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect convenience with a changing environment of power
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Become curious about dependencies that emerge gradually

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin in Mara’s household, and ask what would have to travel with her if she left.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Ask what Mara would need to take when leaving
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to inspect the practical conditions of exit
